items.description: Convert class parameter defaults to Ansible role defaults: redis_port (6379), redis_password (CHANGEME — must be vaulted), maxmemory_mb (2048), maxmemory_policy (allkeys-lru)
items.notes: All 4 class parameter defaults converted. redis_password injected by AAP credential type at runtime.

items.description: Convert Redis configuration ERB template to Jinja2; replace @facts['networking']['fqdn'] → {{ ansible_fqdn }}, @redis_port → {{ redis_cluster_case2_redis_port }}, @redis_password → {{ redis_cluster_case2_redis_password }}, @maxmemory_mb → {{ redis_cluster_case2_maxmemory_mb }}, @maxmemory_policy → {{ redis_cluster_case2_maxmemory_policy }}
items.notes: Replaced hardcoded 'dir /var/lib/redis' with '{{ redis_cluster_case2_data_dir }}' and 'logfile /var/log/redis/redis-server.log' with '{{ redis_cluster_case2_log_dir }}/redis-server.log'. Both variables are defined in defaults/main.yml. The data_dir variable was defined but never consumed — the template was the only place it should have been used.

items.description: Convert init.pp entry class to main tasks: redis_role fact detection (stat + slurp /etc/redis/conf.d/replica.conf), HTTP health-check via ansible.builtin.uri, write /var/lib/redis/health_check.json, myapp deployment (stat version.txt, get_url, unarchive, copy version), mySecretType1 schedulerctl registration (flagged — NOT SAFELY CONVERTIBLE), include install tasks. PuppetDB query replaced by inventory group reference.
items.notes: 1) Moved myapp deployment block before health-check block so the health endpoint (served by myapp on port 8080) is available when the uri task runs. 2) Replaced failed_when on uri task with ignore_errors: true (failed_when only evaluates HTTP status codes; a connection-refused error raises an exception before failed_when is reached, crashing the play). 3) Added 'when: redis_cluster_case2_health_check_result is not failed' to the copy task so the write is skipped gracefully when the endpoint is unavailable.

items.description: Convert install.pp to Ansible tasks: install redis package, deploy redis.conf.j2 template to /etc/redis/redis.conf, ensure redis service is running and enabled, create /var/log/redis directory (owner: redis, group: redis, mode: 0755)
items.notes: Added 'Ensure Redis PID directory exists' task (/var/run/redis, owner redis:redis 0755) between log-dir and template tasks. The pidfile directive in redis.conf.j2 references this directory; without it Redis fails to start on distros that do not pre-create /var/run/redis via tmpfiles.d.
